description: Call this FIRST before any other tool for this provider. Login to COMWEL via NPKI AnySign certificate. Works only when business_registration_no maps to exactly one COMWEL business management number; with two or more the login fails and no input of this tool picks one. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).
